reason: Post-merge review of PR #104 found that the base-owned attestation workflow references Linux and Windows PVEP selftest command-set paths that are not present on trusted main. The older definitions on PR #100 transitively depend on the custom receipt/JCS/signed-executor stack that V2.1 OSS-fit is replacing. The root repair is therefore to add only two self-contained base-owned selftest command sets and explicitly prohibit importing the PR #100 custom trust stack.
mandatoryFailureFirstContracts: The first pull request after PR #104 reproducibly fails the new attestation workflow because the trusted-base command-set paths are absent
The closure adds exactly the Linux and Windows selftest command-set files and no transitive PR #100 trust-stack dependency
After the closure reaches trusted main, the next pull request obtains a real GitHub/Sigstore attestation from the base-owned workflow
